{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Are you kidding me? Every kid from here to Coruscant wants to get their hands on a genuine squill hide jacket! You can't go wrong with squill! That's what I always say - you just can't go wrong! So, you interested or what?|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
A '''commoner''' inhabited [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Just sign this contract here... Good, and here... excellent! All you need to do is to go out here and kill the little buggers! Once you have them down to a manageable level, we'll move in and take over - er - I mean... help guide your business endeavours.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the commoner resided in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During their time in Anchorhead, the commoner became involved with the [[Squill (creature)|squill]] industry.<ref name="SWG:ac" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the commoner employed the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate squill in their respective [[Squill Cave|lair]] and collect squill hide. Pretending that squill hide jackets were very popular in order to encourage the spacer, the commoner avoided to mention that squills were very dangerous creatures.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of the commoner]]
The commoner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ac" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The commoner was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>

In the game, players could enter a dialogue with the commoner concerning the squill industry. After agreeing to help the commoner, players would be given a waypoint to the squill cave on Tatooine. However, aside from receiving the waypoint, players were not required to fulfill any specific objective. Speaking to the commoner simply allowed players to discover the location.<ref name="SWG:ac" />
